title: SAE Endpoints
summary: This module provides API endpoints for interacting with Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) functionalities, including comparing SAE activations and generating SAE snapshots.

nodes.label: SAE Compare Request
nodes.title: SAE Compare Request
nodes.description: Handles incoming requests to compare SAE activations between two systems based on a given message.

nodes.label: SAE Snapshot Request
nodes.title: SAE Snapshot Request
nodes.description: Processes requests to generate a snapshot of SAE activations for a specific system and message.

nodes.label: SAE Experiment Runner
nodes.title: SAE Experiment Runner
nodes.description: Manages the execution of various SAE experiments, including ablation, reconstruction, and comprehensive runs.

nodes.label: SAE Causality Analysis
nodes.title: SAE Causality Analysis
nodes.description: Provides tools and methods for analyzing the causal effects of sparse directions from latent spaces within SAEs.

groups.label: API Endpoints
groups.title: API Endpoints
groups.description: User-facing entry points for interacting with the SAE functionalities.
